criteria.label: Rent (2-bed)
criteria.hint: CMHC avg 2-bedroom rent, Oct survey. Your target: under $2,000

criteria.label: Rural property prices nearby
criteria.hint: Median rural home value in the surrounding regional district / county, 2021 census

criteria.label: Rural homes under $300k
criteria.hint: Share of rural single-detached homes nearby valued under $300k, 2021 census

criteria.label: Forest within 60 km
criteria.hint: Share of land within 60 km that is forest (NRCan land cover 2020)

criteria.label: People aged 25-44
criteria.hint: Share of residents aged 25 to 44, 2021 census

criteria.label: Restaurants, bars & recreation
criteria.hint: Food, drink, arts & recreation businesses per 1,000 people (StatCan business counts)

criteria.label: AI-resistant jobs
criteria.hint: How much of the local workforce does hands-on work AI can't easily replace (2021 census occupations)

criteria.label: Economic diversity
criteria.hint: Effective number of industries employing locals (higher = less reliant on one industry)

criteria.label: Well-paying backup jobs
criteria.hint: Share of workers earning $80k+ from employment, 2021 census

criteria.label: Commercial client base
criteria.hint: Businesses with employees per 1,000 people (StatCan business counts)

criteria.label: Competing contractors
criteria.hint: Building + specialty trade contractor businesses per 1,000 people (lower = less competition)

criteria.label: Older homes (pre-1981)
criteria.hint: Share of homes built before 1981: more repair & reno work

criteria.label: Homes needing repairs
criteria.hint: Share of homes needing minor or major repairs, 2021 census

criteria.label: Airport (only if >8h from Vancouver)
criteria.hint: Drive to nearest airport with scheduled flights; counts as 0 when within 8h of Vancouver

aiModes.gradual: Gradual: office jobs erode over 10+ years
aiModes.fast: Fast takeoff: most desk work automated within a few years, robots start on physical work

sources: CMHC Rental Market Survey, October 2025 (average rent, row + apartment)
Statistics Canada, Canadian Business Counts, with employees, census metropolitan areas and census subdivisions, June 2026
Statistics Canada, 2021 Census of Population (age & gender, occupations & industries, employment income, dwelling condition & age, owner-estimated dwelling values)
Natural Resources Canada, 2020 Land Cover of Canada (forest share within 60 km)
Natural Resources Canada, Canadian Geographical Names (locations)
